summary: The note describes the NHL on ABC, the branding once used for National Hockey League games broadcast on the American Broadcasting Company in the United States. ABC first aired NHL games in the 1992–93 season under a time-buy agreement with ESPN. ABC resumed regular season telecasts on February 6, 2000, under a joint contract with ESPN that also covered select Stanley Cup playoff games from each round.
one_line: NHL on ABC was the branding for NHL games broadcast on the American Broadcasting Company, starting in 1992–93 and resuming in 2000.
key_facts: The NHL on ABC was the branding formerly used for broadcasts of National Hockey League games on the American Broadcasting Company in the United States.
ABC first broadcast NHL games during the 1992–93 season.
ABC's first NHL broadcasts during the 1992–93 season were under a time-buy agreement with ESPN.
ABC resumed regular season NHL game telecasts on February 6, 2000.
The 2000 resumption was part of a joint contract with ESPN.
The joint contract with ESPN gave ABC the rights to select games from each round of the Stanley Cup playoffs.
The National Hockey League is the league whose games were televised under the NHL on ABC branding.
The American Broadcasting Company is the network that carried the NHL on ABC broadcasts.
